rulings.barItem: the wrong era: building on an API the vendor had deprecated by the World's date; a call through a door the vendor does not document
rulings.reason: Act 7 has Scheduler publish the changelog comment as a reply 'with reply_to_message_id'. Telegram replaced that parameter in Bot API 7.0, December 29, 2023 (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog: 'Replaced parameters reply_to_message_id and allow_sending_without_reply in the methods ... with the field reply_parameters'), two years before the story's January 2026, and the reference page the spec is written from (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage, Bot API 10.3) no longer documents it at all, as spec/SOURCE.md itself states; the act builds on a door the vendor withdrew, even though the server still reads it.
rulings.correction: Act 7 sends the reply with reply_parameters (a JSON-serialized ReplyParameters naming the album's first message_id), as https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage documents, and the 'What the story reaches' line says so.
